evals.prompt: Audit eval1_screen_and_idiom_layout.swift for iPhone Duo resizing and pose adaptation anti-patterns.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying hardcoded UIScreen.main.bounds, UIDevice.userInterfaceIdiom layout branching, and rigid fixed-width frames.
expectations: Identifies UIDevice.current.userInterfaceIdiom / orientation check as DUO_IDIOM_OR_ORIENTATION_LAYOUT

evals.prompt: Audit eval2_arrangement_and_fold_hazards.swift for ArrangementView container nesting violations and hinge division grid issues.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging ArrangementView nested inside ScrollView or wrapping NavigationSplitView, plus a 3-column LazyVGrid straddling the center fold.
expectations: Identifies invalid ArrangementView nesting as DUO_ARRANGEMENT_INVALID_NESTING
Identifies 3-column LazyVGrid across fold division as DUO_ODD_GRID_COLUMNS_ON_FOLD

evals.prompt: Audit eval3_vertical_toolbar_hazards.swift for vertical side-bar incompatibilities on iPhone Duo.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging text-only ToolbarItem buttons that fail to appear vertically and manual Spacer/ellipsis overflow patterns.
expectations: Identifies text-only ToolbarItem button as DUO_TOOLBAR_TEXT_ONLY_ITEM
Identifies manual toolbar spacer or custom ellipsis menu as DUO_MANUAL_TOOLBAR_SPACER

evals.prompt: Audit eval4_uikit_custom_bars.swift for UIKit manual bar instantiation that bypasses iPhone Duo vertical side-bar presentation.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging standalone UIToolbar() and UITabBar() subviews.
expectations: Identifies standalone UIToolbar/UITabBar instantiation as DUO_CUSTOM_BAR_BYPASS
